description: Exact review-scenario rows extracted from the completed CI benchmark log. Earlier PR #3 scenarios are intentionally omitted; the complete report is in the identified artifact. The browser job on this run subsequently found a menu-focus bug, fixed in a later commit; this file records CPU/managed-allocation measurements, not an all-tests-pass claim.
methodology: Single-process Stopwatch and current-thread managed allocations. Three warmups, then eleven measurements. Fresh document/snapshot setup and disposal excluded. Previous paths reproduced from the specified baseline. Pooled buffers and interval index are warm. No absolute timing gate, physical GPU, FPS, battery or input-latency claims.

fixtures.tail_literal_search: 4,200,006 UTF-16 characters; search begins at offset 4,200,000 for the final six-character needle. Measures avoiding unnecessary full-document materialization, not whole-document throughput.
fixtures.bracket_scan_sparse: 4,200,002 UTF-16 characters with one matched bracket pair. Both implementations scan the entire snapshot. Pair-storage costs for dense code are not represented.
fixtures.deep_diagnostic_queries_1000: 100,000 one-character ranges ten characters apart; 1,000 queries of offsets 999,950 through 999,999 per sample. Both return five matches per query. Index construction and caller-buffer capacity are excluded.
